visual_action: A slideshow of two static images. The first is a screenshot of a tweet from the account 'FactPost'. The tweet text criticizes the cost of deploying the National Guard to D.C. and is paired with a split image of soldiers near the U.S. Capitol and the Washington, D.C. flag. The second image shows three National Guard soldiers in uniform carrying black trash bags on a brick path.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: The on-screen text of a tweet reads, "New analysis finds Trump's deployment of the National Guard to DC..."

cast.name: National Guard
cast.evidence: The tweet text mentions "deployment of the National Guard," and the images show soldiers in uniform.

cast.name: FactPost
cast.evidence: The video displays a screenshot of a tweet from the account "FactPost" with the handle "@factpostnews".

on_screen_text.text: New analysis finds Trump's deployment of the National Guard to DC costs an estimated $1 million per day.
dropping $1M a day to have soldiers pick up trash

spoken_summary: The video has no spoken words, only instrumental music.
audio_music: A slow, melancholic slide guitar melody plays throughout, creating a sad and mocking tone. The sound is widely recognized as the 'sad SpongeBob music' meme.
editing_pacing: A simple slideshow with a single cut between two static images.
central_claim: Donald Trump wastefully spent $1 million per day to have National Guard soldiers perform menial tasks like picking up trash in Washington D.C.
intended_effect: To generate disapproval of Donald Trump by portraying his decisions as fiscally irresponsible and a misuse of the military.
